verdicts.reason: Both are the same layout and share the same flaws: the window graphic is pushed down-left and starts at x≈155, so it lines up with neither the headline's left edge nor any other element. The date/location block floats to the right of the window's top and is jammed against the headline, and the bottom-right quadrant is a large empty area, so the layout looks unbalanced rather than rearranged for the new shape. A puts the window very close to the bottom edge, with a heavier top margin above it. B has more even top and bottom margins but squeezes the window's arch almost into the headline, so B is only marginally better.
